name: WP Counter Up – Animated Number Counter & Milestone Showcase
author: LogicHunt

sections.description:
Turn your numbers into a visual story with beautifully animated counters designed to capture attention and improve engagement.

Whether you’re a freelancer highlighting completed projects, a digital agency showcasing client success, an eCommerce store displaying products sold, or a business presenting company milestones, WP Counter Up helps transform static numbers into dynamic visual experiences.

Built with performance and flexibility in mind, the plugin delivers smooth scroll-triggered animations while remaining lightweight, responsive, and easy to customize — no coding required.

WP Counter Up by LogicHunt.com

Live Demo | Documentation | Support | Get Pro Version

Why Choose WP Counter Up?

  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Smooth animated number counting on scroll
  • SEO-friendly and responsive design
  • Easy shortcode integration anywhere on your site
  • Flexible layouts with Grid and Flexbox support
  • Works perfectly with Gutenberg and page builders
  • Developer-friendly yet beginner-friendly
  • Modern, clean, and customizable design controls
  • Fully tested with WordPress 7.0
  • Cross-browser and mobile compatible

✅ FREE VERSION FEATURES

Core Counter Features

  • Scroll-triggered animated number counters
  • Smooth count-up animation from zero to target value
  • Support for integers, floats, commas, currency values, and mixed formats
  • Unlimited counter items
  • Lightweight frontend rendering for faster loading

Layout & Display

  • Multiple layout styles: Grid and Flexbox
  • Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Device-based column controls
  • Background image and overlay support
  • Works with all modern WordPress themes

Counter Items

  • Add icons, images, titles, and descriptions
  • Drag & drop item ordering
  • Flexible content arrangement
  • Clean and modern frontend display

Shortcode System

  • Built-in shortcode generator
  • Multiple shortcode instances per page
  • Paste counters anywhere using shortcodes
  • Compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, and other page builders

Styling & Animation

  • CSS3 animation effects
  • Custom spacing and layout settings
  • Responsive design controls
  • Modern hover-ready layouts

⭐ PRO VERSION FEATURES

Unlock advanced layouts, styling, animations, and powerful customization options with the Pro Version.

Advanced Counter Controls

  • Custom animation duration
  • Animation delay controls
  • Category filtering per shortcode
  • Item limit control
  • Sorting options: Drag & Drop, Title, Date, or Random

Flexible Content Layouts

  • 11 content order combinations
  • Left icon layouts and title-first layouts
  • Individual item height controls
  • Enable or disable titles and descriptions

Advanced Styling Options

  • 50+ entrance and hover animations
  • Floating animation effects
  • Hover grayscale and box shadow effects
  • Typography controls for numbers, titles, and descriptions
  • Full control over spacing, padding, borders, radius, and backgrounds

Section Header Builder

  • Section title and subtitle support
  • Typography and color customization
  • Header alignment options
  • Margin and spacing controls

Background & Section Controls

  • Background image settings
  • Background attachment controls
  • Overlay color with opacity
  • Section width and container controls
  • Section margin and padding customization

Responsive Controls

  • Independent column settings for:
    • Large Desktop
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile

Preloader Support

  • Enable section preloaders
  • Custom preloader background colors and icons

Perfect For

  • Digital agencies
  • Business websites
  • eCommerce stores
  • SaaS landing pages
  • Non-profit organizations
  • Startup websites
  • Corporate KPI displays
  • Portfolio websites
  • Marketing campaigns
  • Event and milestone showcases

What Can You Count?

  • Integers: 1234
  • Floats: 1.234
  • Numbers with commas: 1,234
  • Currency values: $1,234.56
  • Percentage values: 95%
  • Mixed formats: 12,345.67
  • Time-based values: hours, days, minutes, seconds
  • Non-numeric content containing numbers

Basic Counter Item Fields

  • Title
  • Icon / Image
  • Count Value
  • Description

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Counter Up → Add New
  3. Create your counter items
  4. Open the Shortcode Generator
  5. Generate and copy your shortcode
  6. Paste the shortcode anywhere on your site
sections.installation:
Via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “WP Counter Up”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Upload

  1. Download wp-counter-up.zip
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
How do I add counters to my website?

Create your counter items from the WordPress dashboard, generate a shortcode using the Shortcode Generator, and paste the shortcode into any page, post, widget, or page builder section.

Can I display multiple counter groups on one page?

Yes. You can create unlimited shortcode groups and place multiple counter sections anywhere on your site.

Does the plugin work with Elementor or Divi?

Yes. WP Counter Up works perfectly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery, and most modern WordPress page builders.

Can I customize layouts and colors?

Absolutely. You can customize layouts, colors, typography, spacing, animations, backgrounds, overlays, and responsive column settings.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes. All counter layouts are fully responsive and optimized for desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

What number formats are supported?

The plugin supports integers, decimals, commas, currency symbols, percentages, and mixed numeric content.

Is the Pro version a separate plugin?

Yes. The Pro version is an add-on plugin that extends the functionality of the free version.
